mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN entry_date < #{begin} AND (status <> 'LEFT' OR leave_date IS NULL OR leave_date >= #{begin}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS headcount_start, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN entry_date <= #{end} AND (status <> 'LEFT' OR leave_date IS NULL OR leave_date > #{end}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS headcount_end, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN entry_date >= #{begin} AND entry_date <= #{end} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS hires, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'LEFT' AND leave_date >= #{begin} AND leave_date <= #{end} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS leaves FROM hr_employee
